record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly increase learning rate from 6e-4 to 8e-4 and reduce dropout from 0.10 to 0.05. Faster optimization with less stochastic suppression may better fit the short histories; the lower-rate, higher-dropout configuration regressed. Retain width 48, six causal blocks, batch size 128, Adam, and all feature, embedding, interaction, readout and loss definitions.

category_rationales.rationale: Jointly increase learning rate to 8e-4 and reduce dropout to 0.05 across all four category models. Faster updates with less stochastic suppression may improve fitting of short histories. Preserve width 48, six causal blocks, batch size 128, Adam, existing model formulas, and one checkpoint per category. Predictor shapes remain compatible.
